question: Where’s the closest gallery along the path to Candlestick Park, Four Oaks, NC starting at Aquarium Outfitters Carolina, Wake Forest, NC?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-78.515805 35.970785)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-78.432567 35.431626)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE tourism = 'gallery'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-78.515805 35.970785)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-78.515805 35.970785)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: Aquarium Outfitters Carolina, Wake Forest, NC

poi.description: Community town park with baseball fields.
